title.zh: 修订经修正的《修订行政法典》第1659条的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section One Thousand Six Hundred Fifty-Nine of the Revised Administrative Code, as Amended
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section One Thousand Six Hundred Fifty-Nine of the Revised Administrative Code, as Amended

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_335_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: To carry out the purposes of this Act and in addition to such sum as may have been provided for under current appropriation, there is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated the amount of twenty-nine thousand four hundred pesos for the fiscal year 1948-1949.

This Act shall take effect on July 1, 1948.
Approved: July 20, 1948.
